arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'config' AS kind, service AS id, value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'pending', b.booking_id, json_object('request_id',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'cancel',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event',e.event_id,'step',e.step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id)) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',event_id,json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights

SELECT 'config' AS kind,service AS id,value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'pending',b.booking_id,json_object('request_id',b.request_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'cancel',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event',e.event_id,'step',e.step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id)) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',o.event_id,json_object('booking_id',o.booking_id,'payload',o.payload,'attempts',o.attempts,'booking_status',b.status,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id) FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=o.booking_id WHERE o.status='pending'

SELECT 'booking_integrity' AS kind,json_object('pending',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending'),'confirmed_missing_hold',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (h.booking_id IS NULL OR h.flight_id<>b.flight_id OR h.passenger_id<>b.passenger_id)),'confirmed_missing_checkin',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN checkins c USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (c.booking_id IS NULL OR c.flight_id<>b.flight_id OR c.passenger_id<>b.passenger_id)),'duplicate_sales',(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING count(*)>1)),'oversold',(SELECT count(*) FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity),'bad_confirmed_charges',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND ((SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured')<>1 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents<>b.amount_cents)))) AS data UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled',json_object('id',b.booking_id,'cancel_events',(SELECT count(*) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id),'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'checkins',(SELECT count(*) FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'refunds',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge',r.charge_id,'amount',r.amount_cents)) FROM refunds r WHERE r.booking_id=b.booking_id)) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('status',status,'count',count(*)) FROM outbox GROUP BY status
